_finding: Coverage is a continuous, unimodal, right-skewed quantity. On the CANONICAL coupling it has no significant spatial axis: rho(coverage,|x|) = -0.03 (spin p = 0.83), and A-P, D-V and myelin are null too. The medial->lateral decline (rho = -0.30, p = 0.0005) is specific to the retired pre-warp coupling; see medial_lateral_robustness for the per-coupling comparison.

continuum._reading: Single mode, long thin left tail. No bimodality; there is no discrete covered/uncovered split, only a graded decline into the tail.
